title: Marginally Better Transport
description: Adds wool padding to minecarts and boats, so your butt won't ache after all that sitting.
body: Personal resource pack to make boats and minecarts a little bit fancier by adding wool pading to their seating areas and giving minecarts a nice gold trim. It was part of a personal resource pack I was making but I thought it looked nice so I separated it into it's own pack.
